analogy.rationale: Choleretic agents promote bile flow, a hepatic function not captured by the 978 landmark genes in these cell lines, so little transcriptional response is expected. The closest listed classes are other bile/liver-related or transporter mechanisms, but none share a transcriptional program in these cells.
